description: Emmanuel Mhango publishes openwashdata/wastedata, a collection of survey records describing waste-disposal sites, cemeteries and burial grounds in Malawi. Enumerators used the mWater application with support from the World Food Programme. The stated purpose is to document service coverage, assess environmental risks and inform waste-management planning. The October 2025 Zenodo deposit preserves version 1.0.0 as a ZIP repository snapshot and links the project's dataset documentation. CC BY 4.0 allows free reuse. Site observations can provide facility inputs for accessibility, service-capacity or environmental-exposure models. The landing page does not state the fieldwork period, complete geographic coverage, coordinate accuracy or internal table formats. National scope therefore identifies the country of the survey, not a verified complete census of its facilities. No files were downloaded, and no related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
